role: TileEntityRendererDispatcher and the tile-entity renderers the game reaches, over a recorded frame's RenderGlobal.tileEntities (TileEntityRenderProbe's tes block): chests single, double and trapped with the lid ease, ender chests, signs with their four lines, skulls of every type on floors and walls, the spawner's spinning mob (through raster_mobs_draw) RenderEndPortal's sixteen projective layers and RenderEnchantmentTable's book (ModelBook); plus the client halves of the state they read, the chest lid step and the spawner spin, one tick each.

structs.name: te_render_item
structs.java: one RenderGlobal.tileEntities entry: the TileEntity's position, block, metadata and brightness, and each renderer's fields (TileEntityChest lidAngle, prevLidAngle and adjacent chests; TileEntitySign's lines and lineBeingEdited; TileEntitySkull's type and rotation; MobSpawnerBaseLogic's rotation pair and its display entity)

structs.name: te_render_frame
structs.java: the dispatcher's viewer (staticPlayerX/Y/Z, field_147560_j/k/l), ActiveRenderInfo.objectX/Y/Z, the partial tick and Minecraft.getSystemTime

structs.name: te_ctx
structs.java: the GL state the loop threads through the renderers: the modelview, the item lights in eye space, glColor, the lightmap coordinates, GL_CULL_FACE, GL_RESCALE_NORMAL and the depth mask

gpu: line 59-62, file scope: static mutable texture cache and font metrics (textures, textures_from, font, font_loaded) filled lazily from disk
line 89, function tex: malloc per texture on first use, and fopen of the scene's state/te_*.rgba with cwd-relative csrc/assets fallbacks (line 101)
line 945, function lastline: getline over the whole frames.jsonl with a strdup per line
line 974, function raster_tileents_scene: calloc of the item list per frame
notes: Hooked in raster.c draw_mesh after raster_mobs_scene (vanilla draws the block entities after the entities). Positions go through Mesa's matrix arithmetic (rs_gl_*), the depth through linear window z (the entity rasterizer's default perspective-interpolated depth hid the chest knob behind the lid). Scenes: out/java/rendertick/te_chests, te_signs, te_skulls, te_spawner, te_dungeon, te_portal_sh, te_portal_end; 43 frame views, no pxdiff cluster. lane/covframes: te_render_frame.normalize is GL_NORMALIZE, which RenderSlime.shouldRenderPass turns on for good; eye_normal then makes the normal unit length, so a sign board (scaled 2/3 without GL_RESCALE_NORMAL) lit after a slime is 0.81 as bright (cov-zoo-s1 108 2,328 to 410 px).
